entry.title: Kankoda Design System
entry.content:
Say hello to the Kankoda Design System. This site defines shared styles and components for Kankoda’s various product sites, and will be extended with example renderings later on.

There’s not much here at the moment, but we will add and tweak styles over time, then sync the changes to the various web sites.
